title: Take-up Rates at School-based and Community-based Student Care Centres
what_it_is: Take-up Rates at School-based and Community-based Student Care Centres

sections.label: Primary school and community SCCs
sections.summary: All 182 primary schools have SCCs with about 33,000 students, and about 190 community-based SCCs have about 8,300 students, with required programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All 182 primary schools have SCCs, with a total enrolment of about 33,000 students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There are about 190 community-based SCCs that are registered with MSF, with a total enrolment of about 8,300 students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: School-based SCCs are required to provide weekly outdoor programmes and enrichment activities, including reading, speech and drama, creative writing, music and art, to develop values, socio-emotional competencies and 21st century competencies in our students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: All registered community-based SCCs are required to meet standards stipulated by MSF, which includes providing a structured daily programme for their students.

sections.label: Reviewing school-based SCC programmes
sections.summary: School-based SCC programmes will continue to be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The short answer is yes, we will continue to review the programmes offered at our school-based SCCs.

sections.label: Monitoring SCC enrolment and wait lists
sections.summary: MOE and MSF closely monitor enrolment in school-based and community-based SCCs, and most SCCs have no or very short wait lists.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Both MOE and MSF together monitor very closely the enrolment of students in both the school-based SCCs, as well as the community-based SCCs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As of now, most SCCs do not have a wait list, or they have a very short wait list.
